title: Star Wars
description: A chronological saga walk-through using in-universe BBY/ABY years (Battle of Yavin = 0). Includes the Skywalker films, animated series, and Disney+ live action. Skip standalone entries on a first watch if you prefer.

groups.name: The High Republic Era
groups.blurb: Optional prologue, set roughly 232–132 BBY.

groups.name: Prequel Era
groups.blurb: Fall of the Republic, rise of the Empire. 32–19 BBY.

groups.name: Reign of the Empire
groups.blurb: The dark times. 13–0 BBY.

groups.name: The Original Trilogy
groups.blurb: 0 BBY – 4 ABY.

groups.name: The New Republic Era
groups.blurb: Mando-verse and the seeds of the First Order. 9–11 ABY.

groups.name: Legends Branch
groups.blurb: Pre-Disney Expanded Universe. No longer canon, but still tracked. Branches off from the main Lucas continuity.

groups.name: Standalone
groups.blurb: No fixed place in the chronology.

entries.name: The Acolyte
entries.note: Set at the end of the High Republic, a century before Phantom Menace. Cancelled after one season.

entries.name: Episode II: Attack of the Clones
The Clone Wars
entries.note: Theatrical pilot for the series.

entries.name: The Clone Wars (Series)
entries.note: Watch in chronological episode order (Lucasfilm official guide), not air order. Season 7 overlaps with Episode III.

entries.name: Tales of the Jedi (Vol. 1)
entries.note: Anthology covering Dooku's fall (~68–32 BBY) and Ahsoka's journey during/after the Clone Wars.

entries.name: Tales of the Jedi (Vol. 2)
entries.note: Second volume spanning from the High Republic era to the end of the Clone Wars.

entries.name: Episode III: Revenge of the Sith
The Bad Batch
entries.note: Order 66 aftermath. Spans all three seasons.

entries.name: Solo: A Star Wars Story
entries.note: Prologue on Corellia at ~13 BBY, main heist story at ~10 BBY.

entries.name: Andor
entries.note: Season 1 covers 5 BBY. Season 2 (2025) takes the story through to just before Rogue One.

entries.name: Star Wars Rebels
entries.note: Runs concurrently with Andor's timeline.

entries.name: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
entries.note: Events immediately before Episode IV.

entries.name: Episode V: The Empire Strikes Back
Episode VI: Return of the Jedi
The Book of Boba Fett
entries.note: Episodes 5 and 6 crossover directly with Mandalorian.

entries.name: Ahsoka
entries.note: Season 2 confirmed in development.

entries.name: The Mandalorian & Grogu
entries.note: Theatrical film continuing the Mandalorian storyline post-Season 3.

entries.name: Resistance
entries.note: Runs concurrent with Episodes VII–VIII.

entries.name: Episode IX: The Rise of Skywalker
Star Wars: Clone Wars (2003)
entries.note: Tartakovsky's micro-series; classified as Legends.

entries.name: Caravan of Courage: An Ewok Adventure
Star Wars Visions
entries.note: Anthology. Generally non-canon, no fixed timeline placement.

entries.name: Tales of the Empire
entries.note: Companion to Tales of the Jedi; Morgan Elsbeth and Barriss Offee arcs. Spans Clone Wars through post-OT era.

entries.name: Forces of Destiny
entries.note: Short-form vignettes spanning the saga.

title: DC Extended Universe
description: The 2013–2023 Snyder-led continuity, ending with Aquaman and the Lost Kingdom before James Gunn's reboot. Arranged by in-universe chronological year. Snyder's Justice League is included as an alternate cut branch.

groups.name: Foundation
groups.blurb: The earliest events, from WWI to the formation of the Justice League.

groups.name: The Justice League Era
groups.blurb: Two distinct cuts of the same story exist; pick one — they are not both canon.

groups.name: Solo Expansion
groups.blurb: Hero-led films released between Justice League and the soft reboot.

groups.name: Closing Chapter
groups.blurb: Final entries before the universe was retired.

groups.name: Standalone
groups.blurb: No fixed place in the chronology.

entries.name: Wonder Woman
entries.note: Mostly set during World War I. Framing scenes are present-day.

entries.name: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice
entries.note: Theatrical cut. The Ultimate Edition adds 30 minutes.

entries.name: Justice League
entries.note: Theatrical cut, completed by Joss Whedon.

entries.name: Zack Snyder's Justice League
entries.note: Extended director's cut released on HBO Max; alternate continuity.

entries.name: Birds of Prey
entries.note: Set ~3 years after Suicide Squad.

entries.name: Peacemaker
entries.note: Set days after The Suicide Squad. Season 2 was retconned into the new DCU.

entries.name: The Flash
entries.note: Concludes the timeline by collapsing it into the multiverse.

entries.name: Blue Beetle
entries.note: Originally DCEU, re-canonised into the DCU.

entries.name: Justice League Dark: Apokolips War
entries.note: DC animated, not part of DCEU. Often paired thematically with the Snyder cut.

title: DC Universe (Gunn / Safran)
description: James Gunn and Peter Safran's 2025 reboot, branded Chapter One: Gods and Monsters. A connected slate across film, animation, and television.

groups.name: Chapter One · Gods and Monsters
groups.blurb: The launch slate, sharing characters and continuity across mediums.

groups.name: Elseworlds
groups.blurb: Films explicitly outside DCU continuity but still actively produced.

groups.name: Standalone
groups.blurb: No fixed place in the chronology.

entries.name: Creature Commandos
entries.note: First DCU project, animated. Establishes Amanda Waller's status quo.

entries.name: Superman
entries.note: Set three years into Superman's career on Earth. The true launchpad of the DCU.

entries.name: Peacemaker Season 2
entries.note: Carries Cena and most of the cast from the DCEU show into new continuity.

entries.name: Supergirl: Woman of Tomorrow
entries.note: Adapted from Tom King's Woman of Tomorrow.

entries.name: Clayface
entries.note: Standalone body-horror entry within the shared universe.

entries.name: Lanterns
entries.note: True-detective style story with Hal Jordan and John Stewart.

entries.name: Joker: Folie à Deux
entries.note: Set approximately 2 years after the first film.

entries.name: The Batman
entries.note: Year Two of Batman's career.

entries.name: The Penguin
entries.note: Set weeks after The Batman.

entries.name: Watchmen: Chapter I
entries.note: Adaptation of the graphic novel; not part of DCU continuity.

title: The Lord of the Rings & The Hobbit
description: Peter Jackson's two trilogies plus surrounding adaptations, ordered by Middle-earth chronology. The Second Age precedes the Third Age by thousands of years. Theatrical and Extended Editions are listed where relevant.

groups.name: The Rings of Power
groups.blurb: Amazon series, set in the Second Age — thousands of years before the films. Covers approximately SA 1500–3441.

groups.name: The War of the Rohirrim
groups.blurb: Set roughly 200 years before the main Lord of the Rings story.

groups.name: The Hobbit Trilogy
groups.blurb: Bilbo's journey, set in TA 2941–2942. Watch in either theatrical or extended order.

groups.name: Interlude · The Hunt for Gollum
groups.blurb: Between Bilbo's farewell party (TA 3001) and Frodo's departure. Gandalf and Aragorn search for Gollum.

groups.name: The Lord of the Rings Trilogy
groups.blurb: TA 3018–3019. The journey of the One Ring.

groups.name: Bakshi & Rankin/Bass
groups.blurb: Earlier animated adaptations. Different continuity, different style; a separate branch.

entries.name: The Rings of Power · Season 1
entries.note: Compresses thousands of years of Second Age history. Celebrimbor forges the Rings.

entries.name: The Rings of Power · Season 2
entries.note: Continues through Sauron's rise and the forging of the One Ring.

entries.name: The War of the Rohirrim
entries.note: Helm Hammerhand's stand at the Hornburg. Set in TA 2758–2759.

entries.name: The Hobbit: An Unexpected Journey
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 3h 02m.

entries.name: The Hobbit: The Desolation of Smaug
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 3h 06m.

entries.name: The Hobbit: The Battle of the Five Armies
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 2h 44m. The Battle itself takes place at the turn of TA 2941–2942.

entries.name: The Hunt for Gollum
entries.note: Andy Serkis-directed, set approximately TA 3009–3017. Covers Gandalf and Aragorn's hunt for Gollum after Bilbo's birthday.

entries.name: The Fellowship of the Ring
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 3h 48m.

entries.name: The Two Towers
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 3h 43m.

entries.name: The Return of the King
entries.note: Extended Edition runs 4h 11m. March 25, TA 3019 — the fall of Sauron.

entries.name: The Lord of the Rings (1978)
entries.note: Bakshi's rotoscoped film, covers Fellowship and half of Two Towers.

entries.name: The Return of the King (1980)
entries.note: Rankin/Bass; loosely picks up where Bakshi left off.
